concerns.text: FR-003 (NRC/VADER lexicon switch) and SC-003 (robustness via threshold sweep) are unverified. Task T021 (Valence Calculation) is present but the logic for the <50% coverage check and the 'switch to VADER' mechanism is described as 'truncated' in the analyze report. The task description mentions the fallback but lacks the explicit logic to calculate coverage and trigger the switch, which is required to satisfy FR-003.

FR-004 (mixed-effects regression) and SC-002 (p-value for interaction) are unimplemented. Task T024 (Regression Analysis) is present but the model fitting logic is marked as 'FAILED: unspecified' in the analyze report. The task description lists the formula but lacks the implementation details for fitting the model and applying Holm-Bonferroni correction, which are required to satisfy FR-004 and FR-007.

FR-005 (sensitivity analysis) and SC-003 (variation in mean belief rating) are unmet. Task T033 (Robustness Sweep) is present but the loop execution logic is missing. The task description mentions the sweep but does not detail the iteration over thresholds {50ms, 100ms, 150ms} or the generation of the `robustness_report.csv` with the required columns, which is required to satisfy FR-005 and SC-003.

FR-002 (filter >20% data loss) and SC-001 (measure exclusion proportion) are blocked. Task T007 (Data Quality Report) is present but depends on T018 (Preprocess Gaze) which is incomplete. The task T007 description does not explicitly state that it calculates the proportion of excluded participants against the 20% threshold, which is required to satisfy SC-001.

FR-006 (causal framing) is weakly supported. Task T028 (Causal Framing Statement) is in the Polish phase. While it mentions dynamic reporting, the task description does not explicitly state that it frames findings as causal based on the experimental design, which is required to satisfy FR-006.
